script:
Steven (Prison Guard)
Congratulations, you have become guard Steven
You've been a prison guard for ten years. You know how to subdue these unruly criminals and how to earn some "extra income" for yourself. Of course, facing a gang boss like Johnny, you still can't afford to offend him. You know very well that this kind of person will be released sooner or later, and you'll be the one to suffer then. Originally, when Johnny and John were imprisoned, you specifically put them together, but three months later another member of their gang, Ken, was imprisoned for fighting. Johnny indicated to you that he wanted a room to himself, so he gave you money to bribe you to put John and Ken in the adjacent cell. Later, your contact and communication with Johnny became very frequent. He always gave you a considerable sum of money and asked you to bring some "contraband" from outside. This money was much more than what you earned as a small prison guard, so you were very willing to do these things, although this was explicitly prohibited by your prison.
On the night Johnny died, unfortunately you were the only guard in this building, which is also why you were listed as a suspect. What made you even more depressed was that you had just brought back an expensive bottle of red wine for Johnny from outside that day, and the money Johnny gave you was three times the value of this bottle of wine. According to Johnny's habit, he liked to taste wine alone in the bathroom because it happened to be Johnny's turn to clean the bathroom today. You stood guard outside the door. Except for when you had diarrhea and went to the toilet in the middle, no one entered or left the bathroom. But you can confirm that Johnny returned to his cell. But when you went to check in the bathroom, you found that Johnny had left the unfinished wine bottle on the chair - he seemed to have left in a hurry. You didn't know where to put the red wine for a moment because alcohol was prohibited in prison, and you had some business to handle immediately. You had to put it in the bathroom's ventilation opening. You didn't see Johnny return to his cell, but in the evening you heard Johnny making phone calls in room 1602 (because of your cells' special structure, the rooms don't need locks).
You stayed in your office on duty all night, and because you were too tired, you fell asleep. When you woke up, it was already the next morning. Due to your professional habit, you got up very early and called the prisoners to get up as usual. But when you reached room 1602, you saw Johnny's body, back facing the cell door, hanged.
Your Dark Side:
You often oppress prisoners, accept bribes from prisoners, and privately do things prohibited by the prison, especially many things you did with Johnny. The most excessive thing was that Johnny gave you a large sum of money, and you provided Johnny with communication equipment, allowing him to continue controlling his gang.
Character Relationships:

1601 John - You communicate little with them. He was imprisoned with Johnny and is Johnny's subordinate
1601 Ken - Imprisoned 3 months after Johnny, also said to be Johnny's subordinate, but has a very violent temper, often fights in prison, doesn't obey discipline. According to the doctor's diagnosis, he has mental illness
1603 Andrew - You always thought he was wrongly imprisoned, because how could such a madman be imprisoned for economic crimes? In your view, he's just a crazy cultist. Oh, right, he was responsible for cleaning the corridor today
1603 Clark - Besides Johnny, you don't dare provoke this big guy either. He's very strong but rarely speaks, fortunately he's quite rule-abiding
Janitor George - Hired as a cheap janitor due to insufficient prison staff, but prisoners are usually made to do cleaning. George's main task is cleaning prisoners' rooms. He has some mobility issues with his legs

Your Statement to the Detective:
Respected Detective:
Please believe me, I am innocent. I was the first to discover the body. From the condition of the body, it should have died last night, but I think this is just a suicide case. I fell asleep in the office at night because I was too tired, but I guarantee there were no abnormal sounds, otherwise I would definitely have woken up. Johnny was about to be released after serving his sentence - I really don't know why he couldn't think it through. He hasn't shown any abnormalities recently, just often asking me to bring him some good food and drink from outside. I thought this was nothing, so I brought some to share with him. The last time I saw Johnny was yesterday afternoon when he went to clean the bathroom. I was monitoring him outside the whole time, ensuring nothing else happened. When the time was about up, he came out. He was in his cell the rest of the time. Although he was alone in a cell with no one to prove where he was at other times, this is a prison after all - the cell doors can't be opened from inside. So I think how could Johnny possibly be murdered, unless someone entered the cell from outside, didn't close the door, killed Johnny and then left. In this case, janitor George would be most likely to kill someone. Detective, you should interrogate him. I'm the first discoverer - I couldn't be crying thief while being the thief myself. Oh, right, you ask about the body's characteristics - I didn't look carefully. I was just calling prisoners to get up in the morning and discovered Johnny hanging there through the small window on the door, facing the cell door with a terrifying expression, but not ferocious. When I opened the door to check, Johnny's body was already cold. I immediately woke up the prisoners in the adjacent cell and called the police. That's what happened. I hope you don't consider me a suspect anymore. That's all I have to say, thank you.
acts_goal:
Find the killer
Guard your dark side
